observations: Wooden open wardrobe/shelving unit with multiple cube compartments on the left and center, filled with folded clothes (jeans, shirts).
Right side has a hanging rail section with clothes on hangers.
Unit appears light-colored wood or wood-veneer, boxy construction.
Floor around the unit is cluttered with loose clothes and items, making it hard to see the base/legs of the wardrobe.
No brand marks, labels, or model numbers visible anywhere on the unit.
Image is low resolution with a watermark pattern, obscuring fine detail of joints, material quality, and surface condition.
A broom and some other object lean against the left side, partially blocking the view of that section.

identity.kind: open wardrobe (cube/shelf and hanging rail unit)

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows an open shelving/hanging unit consistent with an open wardrobe

claims.claim: Can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: This is a suggestion of use, not a verifiable physical fact

risks.risk: Structural integrity (wobbling, weak joints, broken shelves) cannot be assessed from a single cluttered, low-res photo
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of joints, shelf undersides, and a video showing the unit being lightly shaken

risks.risk: Material quality (real wood vs particle board/laminate) is unclear
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a raw edge or corner showing material cross-section

risks.risk: Actual dimensions unknown, affecting fit and value
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against height, width, depth
risks.if_unproven: priced using smallest plausible estimate from image proportions

risks.risk: Hidden damage, stains, insect/termite damage, or water damage on back/base not visible due to clutter
risks.proof: Photos of the empty unit with all items and clutter removed, all sides visible

risks.risk: Missing or broken hanging rail hardware not fully visible
risks.proof: Close-up of the rail and its mounting brackets
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming rail hardware may need repair

proof_requests: Photos of the empty wardrobe (clothes removed) from front, back, and both sides
Close-up of any joints, corners, and the hanging rail mounting
Photo with a tape measure showing height, width, and depth
Photo of the base/legs and floor contact points
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an open wardrobe unit; despite clutter and unverified structural/material claims, a worst-case price can be set pending further proof.
